purpose: Indonesia-based EPS/G-to-G applicant community acquisition map. Count ecosystems/operators, not every sibling channel, to avoid inflated reach and duplicate outreach.

scoring.A: High applicant density and an actionable admin/community route.
scoring.B: Relevant audience but weaker activity, mixed audience, or contact friction.
scoring.C: Monitor/verify; inactive, future feature, old evidence, or country mismatch.

safetyRules: No member lists or personal data requests.
If promotion/ads are prohibited, request moderator permission rather than posting directly.
If the operator/source is already sent/closed/delivery_failed, do not send a new initial outreach.
Follow-up requires an explicit followup-ready ledger state.
